verdict.rationale: Referral flows are a fair question for an applicant tracking system, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions employee referrals, a referral submission flow, or referral status tracking. The candidate-creation API, careers page, and pipeline stages endpoint are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a referral capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
